turns.text: Good day and welcome to the earnings conference call.
Order growth was solid and backlog increased. Demand for construction equipment was strong in North America.
Backlog rose to a record. Book-to-bill was above one. Pricing more than offset cost inflation. Dealer inventory normalized.
How is backlog and dealer inventory trending?
Backlog grew and dealer inventory is healthy. Order growth remains strong though lead times are shortening.
